MATCH (ownerA)-[:GUARANTEE]->(ownerB)
MATCH (ownerB)-[:GUARANTEE]->(ownerA)

MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)

MATCH (ownerB {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE ownerA <> ownerB
MATCH (ownerA)-[:GUARANTEE]-(ownerB)
MATCH (device:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
MATCH (device)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)

MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no
MATCH (owner1 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
MATCH (owner2 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE owner1.id <> owner2.id AND (owner1:Person OR owner1:Company) AND (owner2:Person OR owner2:Company)
MATCH (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]-(owner2)
MATCH (device:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a1)
MATCH (device)-[:SIGN_IN]->(a2)
RETURN a1.acct_no AS acct1, a2.acct_no AS acct2

MATCH (ownerA {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (ownerB {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE ownerA <> ownerB
MATCH (ownerA)-[:GUARANTEE]-(ownerB)
MATCH (device:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
MATCH (device)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)

/* accept-cost */
MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no
MATCH (owner1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
MATCH (owner2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2
MATCH (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]-(owner2)
MATCH (d:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a1)
MATCH (d)-[:SIGN_IN]->(a2)
RETURN a1.acct_no AS acct1, a2.acct_no AS acct2
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[tr:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE tr.amount < 10000000
WITH owner.id AS owner_id, tgt.id AS tgt_id, count(DISTINCT src.id) AS src_cnt
WITH owner_id, max(src_cnt) AS max_cnt
ORDER BY max_cnt DESC
RETURN owner_id, max_cnt AS account_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[t:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE t.amount < 10000000
WITH owner.id AS ownerId, target.acct_no AS targetAcct, count(DISTINCT src.acct_no) AS srcCount
ORDER BY srcCount DESC, ownerId
RETURN ownerId AS owner_id, srcCount AS account_count, targetAcct AS target_account
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE t.amount < 10000000
WITH owner.id AS owner_id, tgt.id AS tgt_id, count(DISTINCT src.id) AS srcCount
ORDER BY srcCount DESC
RETURN owner_id, tgt_id, srcCount AS account_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (sender)-[t:TRANSFER]->(beneficiary:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE t.amount < 10000000
WITH owner.id AS ownerId, beneficiary.id AS benId, count(DISTINCT sender) AS cnt
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN ownerId, cnt

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id}), (owner)-[:OWN]->(a2:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})
WHERE a1 <> a2
MATCH (a1)-[:TRANSFER]->(a2)
RETURN count(DISTINCT a1.id + "|" + a2.id) AS pairCount

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(a2:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})
WHERE a1 <> a2 AND (owner)-[:OWN]->(a2)
WITH DISTINCT a1.acct_no AS acct1, a2.acct_no AS acct2
RETURN count(*) AS pair_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id}), (owner)-[:OWN]->(a2:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})
WHERE a1 <> a2

RETURN count(DISTINCT a1.id + "|" + a2.id) AS pairCount

MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(a2:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})
MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE a1.acct_no <> a2.acct_no
WITH DISTINCT a1.acct_no AS from_acct, a2.acct_no AS to_acct
